<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller = function($scope, $timeout, spUtil) {
    var c = this;

    // ── Must match PENDING_STATES in server script ────────────────────
    var PENDING_STATES = ['pending_approval', 'requested', 'submitted'];

    // ── Widget state ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    c.loading          = false;
    c.activeFilter     = 'all';
    c.searchQuery      = '';
    c.filteredRequests = [];

    // Run initial filter once server data is ready
    $timeout(function() {
        c.applyFilter();
    }, 0);

    // ── Tab selection ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    c.setFilter = function(filter) {
        c.activeFilter = filter;
        c.applyFilter();
    };

    // ── Tab filter + search filter combined ───────────────────────────
    c.applyFilter = function() {
        var all = c.data.requests || [];

        var result = all.filter(function(req) {
            switch (c.activeFilter) {
                case 'pending':  return PENDING_STATES.indexOf(req.state) > -1;
                case 'approved': return req.state === 'approved';
                case 'rejected': return req.state === 'rejected';
                default:         return true;
            }
        });

        var q = (c.searchQuery || '').toLowerCase().trim();
        if (q) {
            result = result.filter(function(req) {
                return (req.number     && req.number.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)     > -1) ||
                       (req.pan        && req.pan.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)        > -1) ||
                       (req.donee_site && req.donee_site.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) > -1) ||
                       (req.donor_site && req.donor_site.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) > -1);
            });
        }

        c.filteredRequests = result;
    };

    // ── Toggle the financial detail row ───────────────────────────────
    c.toggleExpand = function(req) {
        req.expanded = !req.expanded;
    };

    // ── Status badge CSS class (maps state → class in CSS) ────────────
    c.getStatusClass = function(state) {
        if (PENDING_STATES.indexOf(state) > -1) return 'csw-status-pending';
        if (state === 'approved')               return 'csw-status-approved';
        if (state === 'rejected')               return 'csw-status-rejected';
        if (state === 'draft')                  return 'csw-status-draft';
        if (state === 'cancelled')              return 'csw-status-cancelled';
        return 'csw-status-default';
    };

    // ── Indian currency formatter ─────────────────────────────────────
    c.formatCurrency = function(amount) {
        if (!amount && amount !== 0) return '\u20B90';
        return '\u20B9' + parseFloat(amount).toLocaleString('en-IN');
    };

    // ── Donor utilization % (drives the progress bar) ─────────────────
    c.getUtilizationPct = function(req) {
        if (!req.donor_current_limit || req.donor_current_limit === 0) return 0;
        return Math.min(Math.round((req.donor_utilized_limit / req.donor_current_limit) * 100), 100);
    };

    // ── Bar colour: green → amber → red by utilization level ──────────
    c.getUtilizationColor = function(req) {
        var pct = c.getUtilizationPct(req);
        if (pct >= 80) return '#dc2626';
        if (pct >= 50) return '#d97706';
        return '#059669';
    };

    // ── True when requested amount exceeds donor's available limit ─────
    c.isOverLimit = function(req) {
        return req.donee_amount > req.donor_available;
    };

    // ── Live refresh from server ──────────────────────────────────────
    // Replace the string below with your widget's actual ID in Service Portal
    c.refreshData = function() {
        c.loading = true;
        spUtil.get('view-credit-limit-swap-requests', {}).then(
            function(response) {
                if (response && response.data) {
                    c.data    = response.data;
                    c.loading = false;
                    c.applyFilter();
                }
            },
            function() {
                c.loading = false;
            }
        );
    };

    // ── Open full record in a new browser tab ─────────────────────────
    c.viewRecord = function(req) {
        window.open('/x_birl3_clm_limit_swap.do?sys_id=' + req.sys_id, '_blank');
    };
};]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>/* ============================================================

}</css><data_table>sp_instance</data_table><demo_data/><description/><docs/><field_list/><has_preview>true</has_preview><id>clm_limit_swap_view_requests</id><internal>false</internal><link><![CDATA[function link(scope, element, attrs, controller) {  }]]></link><name>CLM Limit Swap VIew Requests</name><option_schema/><public>false</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[(function() {

    // ── Single table, no joins ────────────────────────────────────────
    var TABLE = 'x_birl3_clm_limit_swap';

    // Update these to match your exact State choice-field values
    var PENDING_STATES = ['pending_approval', 'requested', 'submitted'];
    var STATE_APPROVED = 'approved';
    var STATE_REJECTED = 'rejected';

    var requests = [];

    var gr = new GlideRecord(TABLE);
    gr.addQuery('requested_by', gs.getUserID());
    gr.orderByDesc('requested_on');
    gr.query();

    while (gr.next()) {
        requests.push({
            sys_id               : gr.getUniqueValue(),
            number               : gr.getValue('number')               || '',
            pan                  : gr.getValue('pan')                  || '',
            swap_scenario        : gr.getDisplayValue('swap_scenario') || '',
            donee_site           : gr.getDisplayValue('donee_site')    || '',
            donor_site           : gr.getDisplayValue('donor_site')    || '',
            donee_amount         : parseFloat(gr.getValue('donee_amount'))         || 0,
            donee_current_limit  : parseFloat(gr.getValue('donee_current_limit'))  || 0,
            donor_current_limit  : parseFloat(gr.getValue('donor_current_limit'))  || 0,
            donor_available      : parseFloat(gr.getValue('donor_available'))      || 0,
            donor_utilized_limit : parseFloat(gr.getValue('donor_utilized_limit')) || 0,
            state                : gr.getValue('state')                || '',
            state_display        : gr.getDisplayValue('state')         || '',
            requested_on         : gr.getDisplayValue('requested_on')  || '',
            donor_tsh            : gr.getDisplayValue('donor_tsh')     || '',
            comments             : gr.getValue('comments')             || ''
        });
    }

    // ── Summary counts used by the header cards ───────────────────────
    data.requests = requests;
    data.total    = requests.length;

    data.pending  = requests.filter(function(r) {
        return PENDING_STATES.indexOf(r.state) > -1;
    }).length;

    data.approved = requests.filter(function(r) {
        return r.state === STATE_APPROVED;
    }).length;

    data.rejected = requests.filter(function(r) {
        return r.state === STATE_REJECTED;
    }).length;

})();]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>amrita.sharma@mindsprint.com</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-05-29 10:12:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>8826989f97450f10be31fa17f053afd7</sys_id><sys_mod_count>13</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CLM Limit Swap VIew Requests</sys_name><sys_package display_value="CLM" source="x_birl3_clm">d01e8ce22bb27e104572f3745e91bfe3</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="CLM">d01e8ce22bb27e104572f3745e91bfe3</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_8826989f97450f10be31fa17f053afd7</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>amrita.sharma@mindsprint.com</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-06-01 12:46:50</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div class="csw-widget">

  <!-- ══════════════════════════════════
       LOADING OVERLAY
  ══════════════════════════════════ -->
  <div class="csw-loading-overlay" ng-if="c.loading">
    <div class="csw-spinner"></div>
    <p>Loading requests…</p>
  </div>

  <!-- ══════════════════════════════════
       HEADER
  ══════════════════════════════════ -->
  <div class="csw-header">
    <div class="csw-header-left">
      <div class="csw-header-icon">
        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
             fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"
             width="24" height="24">
          <path d="M7 16V4m0 0L3 8m4-4l4 4"/>
          <path d="M17 8v12m0 0l4-4m-4 4l-4-4"/>
        </svg>
      </div>
      <div>
        <h3 class="csw-title">Credit Limit Swap — View Requests</h3>
        <p class="csw-subtitle">Track all your swap requests and their current state</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <button class="csw-refresh-btn"
            ng-click="c.refreshData()"
            ng-disabled="c.loading">
      <span class="csw-refresh-icon"
            ng-class="{'csw-spinning': c.loading}">↻</span>
      Refresh
    </button>
  </div>

  <!-- ══════════════════════════════════
       SUMMARY CARDS
  ══════════════════════════════════ -->
  <div class="csw-cards-row">

    <div class="csw-card csw-card-total"
         ng-class="{'csw-card-active': c.activeFilter === 'all'}"
         ng-click="c.setFilter('all')">
      <div class="csw-card-icon csw-icon-total">
        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
             fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"
             width="18" height="18">
          <rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/>
          <line x1="3" y1="9" x2="21" y2="9"/>
          <line x1="9" y1="21" x2="9" y2="9"/>
        </svg>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="csw-card-count csw-count-total">{{c.data.total}}</div>
        <div class="csw-card-label">Total</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="csw-card csw-card-pending"
         ng-class="{'csw-card-active': c.activeFilter === 'pending'}"
         ng-click="c.setFilter('pending')">
      <div class="csw-card-icon csw-icon-pending">
        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
             fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"
             width="18" height="18">
          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
          <polyline points="12 6 12 12 16 14"/>
        </svg>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="csw-card-count csw-count-pending">{{c.data.pending}}</div>
        <div class="csw-card-label">Pending</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="csw-card csw-card-approved"
         ng-class="{'csw-card-active': c.activeFilter === 'approved'}"
         ng-click="c.setFilter('approved')">
      <div class="csw-card-icon csw-icon-approved">
        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
             fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"
             width="18" height="18">
          <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"/>
          <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"/>
        </svg>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="csw-card-count csw-count-approved">{{c.data.approved}}</div>
        <div class="csw-card-label">Approved</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="csw-card csw-card-rejected"
         ng-class="{'csw-card-active': c.activeFilter === 'rejected'}"
         ng-click="c.setFilter('rejected')">
      <div class="csw-card-icon csw-icon-rejected">
        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
             fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"
             width="18" height="18">
          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
          <line x1="15" y1="9" x2="9" y2="15"/>
          <line x1="9" y1="9" x2="15" y2="15"/>
        </svg>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="csw-card-count csw-count-rejected">{{c.data.rejected}}</div>
        <div class="csw-card-label">Rejected</div>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>

  <!-- ══════════════════════════════════
       FILTER BAR
  ══════════════════════════════════ -->
  <div class="csw-filter-bar">
    <div class="csw-tabs">

      <button class="csw-tab"
              ng-class="{'csw-tab-active': c.activeFilter === 'all'}"
              ng-click="c.setFilter('all')">All</button>

      <button class="csw-tab"
              ng-class="{'csw-tab-active': c.activeFilter === 'pending'}"
              ng-click="c.setFilter('pending')">
        Pending
        <span class="csw-tab-badge"
              ng-if="c.data.pending > 0">{{c.data.pending}}</span>
      </button>

      <button class="csw-tab"
              ng-class="{'csw-tab-active': c.activeFilter === 'approved'}"
              ng-click="c.setFilter('approved')">Approved</button>

      <button class="csw-tab"
              ng-class="{'csw-tab-active': c.activeFilter === 'rejected'}"
              ng-click="c.setFilter('rejected')">Rejected</button>

    </div>

    <div class="csw-search-wrap">
      <svg class="csw-search-icon" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
           viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"
           stroke-width="2" width="14" height="14">
        <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/>
        <line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"/>
      </svg>
      <input type="text"
             class="csw-search-input"
             placeholder="Search by request no., PAN, or site code…"
             ng-model="c.searchQuery"
             ng-change="c.applyFilter()" />
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ══════════════════════════════════
       EMPTY STATE
  ══════════════════════════════════ -->
  <div class="csw-empty-state"
       ng-if="!c.loading && c.filteredRequests.length === 0">
    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
         fill="none" stroke="#d1d5db" stroke-width="1.5"
         width="48" height="48">
      <path d="M22 12H2M5.45 5.11L2 12v6a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h16a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-6l-3.45-6.89A2 2 0 0 0 16.76 4H7.24a2 2 0 0 0-1.79 1.11z"/>
      <line x1="6" y1="16" x2="6.01" y2="16"/>
      <line x1="10" y1="16" x2="10.01" y2="16"/>
    </svg>
    <h4>No Requests Found</h4>
    <p>No swap requests match your current filter or search.</p>
  </div>

  <!-- ══════════════════════════════════
       TABLE
  ══════════════════════════════════ -->
  <div class="csw-table-wrap"
       ng-if="!c.loading && c.filteredRequests.length > 0">

    <table class="csw-table">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th class="csw-col-expand"></th>
          <th>Request No.</th>
          <th>PAN</th>
          <th>Donee Site</th>
          <th>Donor Site</th>
          <th>Requested Amount</th>
          <th>Scenario</th>
          <th>Requested On</th>
          <th>State</th>
          <th>Action</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>

        <!-- ng-repeat-start / ng-repeat-end lets us output two <tr>
             elements per request without a wrapper element,
             keeping valid table markup.                              -->

        <!-- ── DATA ROW ── -->
        <tr ng-repeat-start="req in c.filteredRequests track by req.sys_id"
            class="csw-data-row"
            ng-class="{'csw-row-open': req.expanded}">

          <!-- Expand toggle -->
          <td class="csw-col-expand">
            <button class="csw-expand-btn"
                    ng-click="c.toggleExpand(req)"
                    title="{{req.expanded ? 'Hide details' : 'Show financial details'}}">
              <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                   fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"
                   width="11" height="11"
                   class="csw-chevron-icon"
                   ng-class="{'csw-rotated': req.expanded}">
                <polyline points="9 18 15 12 9 6"/>
              </svg>
            </button>
          </td>

          <!-- number -->
          <td><span class="csw-number">{{req.number}}</span></td>

          <!-- pan -->
          <td><span class="csw-pan">{{req.pan || '—'}}</span></td>

          <!-- donee_site -->
          <td>
            <div class="csw-site">
              <span class="csw-site-pill csw-pill-donee">DONEE</span>
              {{req.donee_site}}
            </div>
          </td>

          <!-- donor_site -->
          <td>
            <div class="csw-site">
              <span class="csw-site-pill csw-pill-donor">DONOR</span>
              {{req.donor_site}}
            </div>
          </td>

          <!-- donee_amount -->
          <td class="csw-amount">
            {{c.formatCurrency(req.donee_amount)}}
            <span class="csw-over-tag"
                  ng-if="c.isOverLimit(req)"
                  title="Exceeds donor available limit">⚠ Over limit</span>
          </td>

          <!-- swap_scenario -->
          <td>
            <span class="csw-scenario"
                  ng-if="req.swap_scenario">{{req.swap_scenario}}</span>
            <span ng-if="!req.swap_scenario" class="csw-na">—</span>
          </td>

          <!-- requested_on -->
          <td class="csw-date">{{req.requested_on}}</td>

          <!-- state badge — the only state indicator, no chain -->
          <td>
            <span class="csw-state-badge"
                  ng-class="c.getStatusClass(req.state)">
              <span class="csw-state-dot"></span>
              {{req.state_display || req.state}}
            </span>
          </td>

          <!-- Open record -->
          <td>
            <button class="csw-open-btn"
                    ng-click="c.viewRecord(req)"
                    title="Open full record">
              <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                   fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"
                   width="14" height="14">
                <path d="M18 13v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/>
                <polyline points="15 3 21 3 21 9"/>
                <line x1="10" y1="14" x2="21" y2="3"/>
              </svg>
              Open
            </button>
          </td>

        </tr>

        <!-- ── FINANCIAL DETAIL ROW (no approval chain) ── -->
        <tr ng-repeat-end
            ng-if="req.expanded"
            class="csw-detail-row">
          <td colspan="10">
            <div class="csw-detail-panel">

              <!-- Scenario + Donor TSH strip -->
              <div class="csw-detail-meta"
                   ng-if="req.swap_scenario || req.donor_tsh">
                <span ng-if="req.swap_scenario">
                  <span class="csw-meta-label">Scenario:</span>
                  <span class="csw-meta-val csw-scenario-chip">
                    {{req.swap_scenario}}
                  </span>
                </span>
                <span class="csw-meta-divider"
                      ng-if="req.swap_scenario && req.donor_tsh">|</span>
                <span ng-if="req.donor_tsh">
                  <span class="csw-meta-label">Donor TSH:</span>
                  <span class="csw-meta-val">{{req.donor_tsh}}</span>
                </span>
              </div>

              <!-- Financial metrics — all from the main table -->
              <div class="csw-fin-grid">

                <div class="csw-fin-card csw-fin-highlight">
                  <div class="csw-fin-label">Requested amount</div>
                  <div class="csw-fin-val csw-fin-blue">
                    {{c.formatCurrency(req.donee_amount)}}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div class="csw-fin-card">
                  <div class="csw-fin-label">Donee current limit</div>
                  <div class="csw-fin-val">
                    {{c.formatCurrency(req.donee_current_limit)}}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div class="csw-fin-card">
                  <div class="csw-fin-label">Donor current limit</div>
                  <div class="csw-fin-val">
                    {{c.formatCurrency(req.donor_current_limit)}}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div class="csw-fin-card"
                     ng-class="{'csw-fin-warn': c.isOverLimit(req)}">
                  <div class="csw-fin-label">Donor available limit</div>
                  <div class="csw-fin-val"
                       ng-class="{'csw-fin-red': c.isOverLimit(req)}">
                    {{c.formatCurrency(req.donor_available)}}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div class="csw-fin-card">
                  <div class="csw-fin-label">Donor utilized limit</div>
                  <div class="csw-fin-val">
                    {{c.formatCurrency(req.donor_utilized_limit)}}
                  </div>
                  <div class="csw-bar-track">
                    <div class="csw-bar-fill"
                         ng-style="{
                           'width':            c.getUtilizationPct(req) + '%',
                           'background-color': c.getUtilizationColor(req)
                         }">
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="csw-util-label">
                    {{c.getUtilizationPct(req)}}% utilized
                  </div>
                </div>

              </div>
              <!-- END fin-grid -->

              <!-- Comments -->
              <div class="csw-comments" ng-if="req.comments">
                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                     fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"
                     width="13" height="13">
                  <path d="M21 15a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7l-4 4V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"/>
                </svg>
                {{req.comments}}
              </div>

            </div>
          </td>
        </tr>

      </tbody>
    </table>

    <div class="csw-footer">
      Showing <strong>{{c.filteredRequests.length}}</strong>
      of <strong>{{c.data.total}}</strong> request(s)
    </div>

  </div>
  <!-- END table -->

</div>
<!-- END csw-widget -->]]></template></sp_widget><sys_es_latest_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><id>8826989f97450f10be31fa17f053afd7</id><sys_created_by>amrita.sharma@mindsprint.com</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-05-29 10:12:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>cc26989f97450f10be31fa17f053afdd</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>amrita.sharma@mindsprint.com</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-05-29 10:12:00</sys_updated_on><table>sp_widget</table><use_es_latest>true</use_es_latest></sys_es_latest_script></record_update>
